title: NSA source at collusion meetings with a tech company

tellings.quote: I have a guy who is with NSA who was in meetings with some of the senior seuite people at a major tech and telecommunications company sort of colluding

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner for UFO disclosure, says that he knows a man at the NSA, the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that intercepts communications. Greer says this man sat in meetings with top executives of a major tech and telecommunications company, and that the two sides were, in his words, sort of colluding. Greer told this to podcast host Jesse Michels as part of his claim that UFO secrets are kept by a hidden alliance of government and private business.
